fabrication_route: supplied-flat-plate-controlled mould or cast Toyota-style progressive bump-stop; do not copy decayed rubber or cut a block
base_control: Use the user-supplied one-piece flat steel backing/saddle plate as the pattern for plate outline, thickness, hole pitch, and bond face; if the original plate is weak, make a new deburred coated copy
fastener_control: Measure bolt/stud pitch P and hole/thread D from the supplied flat plate and matching vehicle bracket; holes belong in the flat steel plate, not through the rubber unless the supplied sample proves rubber clearance holes
contact_face_control: Centre flat rectangular strike face on axle strike pad within +/-5 mm; tapered/radiused progressive rubber body bonded/captive to the flat plate; no sharp cuboid
material: NR/SBR automotive bump-stop rubber bonded/captive to one-piece coated flat steel backing plate
tolerance: height 70 +/-1; flat-plate outline/hole features +/-0.5 from supplied sample/vehicle release; rubber/steel bond or captive joint must survive 50 percent compression test
first_article_acceptance: Flat steel backing plate seats on bracket, bolts/studs pass by hand, contacts before shock/tyre/spring/brake-hose hard limit; 50 percent compression test with >=90 percent height recovery after 30 min; plate does not bend and rubber remains bonded/captive
notes: User will provide the original one-piece flat metal backing/saddle piece with the fabrication request. Use it as the bonding and hole-pattern pattern; do not invent rubber mounting holes that the supplied sample does not prove.

material: NR/SBR automotive bump-stop rubber bonded/captive to one-piece coated flat steel backing plate
tolerance: height 60 +/-1; flat-plate outline/hole features +/-0.5 from supplied sample/vehicle release; do not accept 70 mm aftermarket height here; rubber/steel bond or captive joint must survive 50 percent compression test
first_article_acceptance: Flat steel backing plate seats on bracket, bolts/studs pass by hand, contacts before shock/tyre/spring/brake-hose hard limit; 50 percent compression test with >=90 percent height recovery after 30 min; plate does not bend and rubber remains bonded/captive
notes: User will provide the original one-piece flat metal backing/saddle piece with the fabrication request. Right-front height remains 60 mm; reject 70 mm copies unless full-bump release deliberately trims them.
